# Bateaux Mouches

> Official website for Compagnie des Bateaux-Mouches, Paris's premier Seine river cruise operator offering sightseeing tours, lunch and dinner cruises, and special event packages.

Bateaux Mouches has been operating Seine river cruises in Paris since the 1940s, offering panoramic views of iconic landmarks like the Eiffel Tower and Conciergerie. The company provides romantic dining experiences, special occasion packages including marriage proposals and Bastille Day celebrations, and entertainment packages featuring the Crazy Horse cabaret show.

## Key Topics

- Seine river cruises
- Paris sightseeing tours

- [Book a cruise on the river Seine | Bateaux Mouches®](https://www.bateaux-mouches.fr/en/booking): Main booking page for Seine cruises, lunch & dinner options (English)
- [セーヌ川クルーズの予約 | Bateaux Mouches®](https://www.bateaux-mouches.fr/ja/reservation): Booking page for Seine cruises, lunch & dinner cruises (Japanese)
- [Compra de billetes | Bateaux Mouches®](https://www.bateaux-mouches.fr/es/reservation/billetes): Ticket purchase for Seine sightseeing cruises (Spanish)
- [游船时间表、时长、价格以及路线| Bateaux Mouches®](https://www.bateaux-mouches.fr/zh/cruise/information): Seine cruise schedules, pricing, routes & duration info (Chinese)
